fields.summary: With milestone 10 queued, the orchestrator planned milestone 11 from the drafts that reviews and checks discovered during milestones 7 to 10 and that guard the owner's gates. The model check on inbox blockers found that question.answer accepts an already answered question (writing answer-<q>-2) and writes into any change set, even one the question does not block; open and blocking are already computed for the inbox (a question with no live answers link; a blocks link to the change set or to a node it touches or an ancestor). rhiza run start refuses inside an agent session (RHIZA_SESSION set), but rhiza run resume does not, so a session can still drive a run. The command step's stop on exit 75 shipped in #140 but its capability statement still says only that exit codes map to outcomes. Paging log, roadmap and why was judged low value (histories are short; roadmap and why are read whole) and left proposed.
fields.title: Milestone 11: owner gates hold
